Histogram by size 0..4: 5, 33, 114, 80, 24 (total 256). Checked by two independent methods: cm-7c3e0f0c12dd4c12 (set enumeration) and cm-bff22c7f7f7e4dfa (CaDiCaL exact synthesis, unverified_circuits=0).
gap: Still open: (i) minimum De Morgan formula size of MCSP[s] for N=4 and N=8; (ii) minimum one-pass cost (update circuits plus decoder) for S=1,2,...; (iii) formula size of the cheapest one-pass realisation versus the optimal formula.
